entries.title: 2018: The BepiColombo spacecraft is launched on an Ariane 5 rocket to study Mercury.
entries.summary: BepiColombo is a joint mission of the European Space Agency (ESA) and the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) to the planet Mercury. The mission comprises two orbiters: the Mercury Planetary Orbiter (MPO), built and operated by ESA, and Mio, built and operated by JAXA.

entries.title: 2003: The Sloan Great Wall, once the largest cosmic structures known to humanity, is discovered by students at Princeton University.
entries.summary: The Sloan Great Wall (SGW) is a cosmic structure formed by a giant wall of galaxies. Its discovery was announced from Princeton University on October 20, 2003, by J. Richard Gott III, Mario Jurić, and their colleagues, based on data from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey.

entries.title: 1995: Space Shuttle Columbia launches on STS-73.
